model_C_asym_waveshaper.antialias: ADAA first order, F(u)=log(cosh(u)) [23], or 2x oversampling

uad_note.value: UAD 610-A/B and SSL E / Manley are H2-dominant, H2 rising 1 dB per dB of level (x + b*x^2 behaviour); the 610 flavour should sit nearer its clip at default Drive

optional_floor.value: fixed low-level odd-harmonic (H3) floor ~ -82 dBFS absolute (Neve 1073 in UAD)
optional_floor.note: hysteresis/crossover-like term that model A leaves out; around -60 dB relative on a quiet tail, so 'maybe later'

classA_ss.note: UAD 1073 is H3-dominant at all levels; H2 only in the last dB before clip. Replaces the H2 (b~0.1) estimate

optional_floor.value: H3 floor ~ -88 dBFS absolute (API Vision in UAD)

AMSNeve1073.thd: <=0.07% 50 Hz-10 kHz at +20 dBu out (600 ohm, 80 kHz BW)

harmonic_balance.value: H3-dominant at every level; fixed absolute H3 ~ -82 dBFS, so relative THD rises as signal falls (0.1-0.4 % at -30 to -40 dBFS out); H2 only matches H3 in the last dB before clip
harmonic_balance.was: not found in credible measured source; H2 expected from single-ended class A (ESTIMATE)
